Name
Sturtis

History
Sturtis is a bioroid that was researched and created to imitate or surpass Yukika.
Since he was born as a test-tube baby and has been in a laboratory ever since, he has little emotion, but he has a very kind and gentle personality, and is devoted to being useful to others.
She was indifferent to the life and death of others, but as she lived with Yukika and her friends, she gradually became more emotional, and nowadays, she sometimes agitates those with whom she is acquainted, as if they were brats.
(Yukika is suspicious and jealous of the fact that her breasts are larger than the original's, but Sturtis says it is "a product of nature.)

SilencerCo MAXIM 9 Akimbo style

The original weapon is a provisional drawing, so there is no need to paint it the same way.
We would be very happy if you could add some futuristic customization by Mr. Makiyo shine!
(It would be even better if there are differences in customization, paint, etc. for each of the akimbo weapons.)
(It would be great if there are differences in customization, painting, etc. for each Akimbo.

Clothing
Please keep your original tight-fitting futuristic suit.

Poses, situations, etc. are up to you.
That is all.

That is all.
NSFW is only included for the sake of it, so there is no need to give it special consideration.
Basically, we will leave everything up to you, so please draw freely.
Thank you very much for your consideration.

Hello, I hope you are doing well!
I would like to commission an illustration of my OC, Artoria. 

Artoria (180cm): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1G1ISAx97ULYehwu90wB69e-U0EDI8ECc?usp=sharing

[Backstory]
Artoria is a soldier and exorcist for the Vatican. She is ranked as High Exorcist. She is tasked with fighting monsters, demons, and other creatures of darkness. These are grueling battles that often cost the lives of many men, leading the exorcists to be treated as cannon fodder by other branches of the Papal Army. However, her rank is proof of her strength and faith. She draws on the Word of God for her strength; verses from the Bible manifesting as power.
Many become exorcists believing that the more sin the cleanse from the world, the more sin will be cleansed from their souls. However, there is a belief among the exorcists that the more one sins, the more creatures of sin are attracted to them. Artoria is one who believes that, not shying away from vices like smoking, drinking, and lusting. In her words "Whatever sin I commit today is just an extra demon killed tomorrow." It becomes a cycle of sinning to attract more monsters to cleanse more sin from themselves. Nevertheless, those who act like that have been exorcists long enough that they know there is no escape from their fate, so they live to kill as many monsters as they can before it is their time.

[Illustration]
Please have Artoria holding her black Beretta ARX-160. Please draw her with all her gear equipped. Her mask is off her face. Her sword is made of silver. She has a neutral expression with a lit cigarette in her mouth. The cigarette has a red filter on the end. Her clothes and gear are a bit battle-worn. 

The atmosphere of the picture is grey and moody.

Thank you!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1G1ISAx97ULYehwu90wB69e-U0EDI8ECc?usp=sharing

Nice to meet you!
I was really attracted by the gap between the very cute design & the well-drawn firearms. Please let me request an illustration!

[Standing picture material
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1bv3gjAYaJAFGuafBq98UBn3sKM3qlqtG
Haru-san has both Live2D and VRC avatar models, but please use the VRC one that is often used for delivery. She is a pink girl with short hair.
[Request].
Haru-san has been playing the game Escape from Tarkov (EfT) for a long time and still delivers it often.
I would like you to draw Haru-san wearing military equipment!
I will leave the clothing design up to you, but I would like her to wear a tactical vest.
Helmets and hats are not required, but could you please put on a headset and visor?
If possible, it would be great if you could separate the layers and have the headset, visor, and tactical vest (or the entire jacket) switchable on and off.
Reference materials
Please refer to the URL of the standing picture material.
The firearm we would like to have is the OTs-14 "Groza" "Glozer".
Pose and facial expression
The pose of the figure should be as shown in the reference page, with the gun held at a slight angle. You can have him standing or sitting on his knees.
The expression should be a serious and cool face!
If you can give me a different expression, I would appreciate it if you can give me a cute smile or a fidgety expression with glazed-over eyes.

We may use illustrations that Haru herself has given us through her activities.
We may use these illustrations mainly as thumbnails for delivery, X announcements, and so on.
We would appreciate it if you could switch on/off the signature, background, etc. in the PSD file when you deliver it to us, and if you could switch the differences between the two files.

Please excuse my long-windedness!
I know you are busy, but I would appreciate your consideration!

It has been a while.
Thank you very much for your wonderful illustration last time!
This time, I would like to request you to draw Veronica, another one of our children.

I would like to ask you to draw our child and her weapons together in the same style as you drew our child the first time.
Here are the details

Name
Veronica

Background
She used to belong to the military and commanded a platoon, but during an operation, she accidentally discovers a classified military matter that should not be known and becomes a wanted person. Meanwhile, Yukika, who was investigating another matter, encounters a battle between the platoon and a pursuit unit.
Thanks to her and Tatate's efforts, the platoon suffered no casualties, but they were unable to escape due to the difference in strength and were approaching their limits. At that moment, Yukibana appeared in front of the platoon, and in the blink of an eye, she destroyed the pursuit force. Losing her place to return to after that, she agreed to give up her name and serve Yukibana in exchange for his protection of the entire platoon. From that day on, she would live her life as Veronica.
From then on, she became the shield of the organization that continued to protect Yukibana as "Veronica.

Weapons
Vepr-12 Molot

Bulletproof large shield
The shield is so large that it exceeds one's height.
The piles at the bottom of the shield are designed to be freely extendable and retractable by a pile-driver. The piles, made of steel, can penetrate most ground surfaces in an instant, and the self-supporting shield can be used as an improvised shield.
The armor of the main body is made of composite materials, which can protect against armor-piercing rounds from rifles, large-caliber machine guns, and even 40 mm grenade rounds. By adding additional armor, it can withstand several rounds of attack from MBTs.

We would be very happy to receive customizations by Mr. Makiyo shine for the weapons and the large shield.
As for the clothing, please keep the original.
Poses, situations, etc. are up to you.
That is all.

This is a repeat request and for a different child.
If you have any questions, please send me a "conditional resend request".
Thank you very much for your consideration!

HELLO. It's me. An image that combines soldier and military vehicle always seemed difficult to think of since usually focus is on one or the other, yeah? The hardships of the infantry or the pure power (and being RPG bait) of a vehicle... anyway! I have an idea that is based on what a fellow squadmate told me what happened. One RG33 firing upon the enemy, but the soldiers can't open fire since their RoE doesn't permit it. So, how about that red-haired soldier sitting at the back of a RG-33 looking bored while another soldier is taking a piss right next to her, but a bullet is inches away from this fellow soldier..!

Alternatively, a very surprised red-haired soldier noticing someone trying to shoot at the top of an RG-33 while being on the top of it, but having no idea that it was someone shooting at them until the next few rounds came! That's another story from my squadmates, but he actually took a bullet to the leg and another guy took some rounds to the chest. I hope you can find appropriate references online since I don't really have anything good on hand...
